title: Octal D-type transparent latches with 3-state outputs

pins.name: OC
pins.text: output control; high puts the outputs in the high-impedance state; the latches keep working

pins.name: C
pins.text: latch enable: while high the Q outputs follow D; when it goes low the data is latched

functions.text: Shows latch 1 while OC is low; high impedance while OC is high.
Shows latch 2 while OC is low; high impedance while OC is high.
Shows latch 3 while OC is low; high impedance while OC is high.
Shows latch 4 while OC is low; high impedance while OC is high.
Shows latch 5 while OC is low; high impedance while OC is high.
Shows latch 6 while OC is low; high impedance while OC is high.
Shows latch 7 while OC is low; high impedance while OC is high.
Shows latch 8 while OC is low; high impedance while OC is high.

rules: OC does not affect the latches

electrical.notes: SN74LS373 figures (page 6); off-state current +/-20 uA. SN74S373: IOL 20 mA (page 10, VOL test), IOH -6.5 mA (page 9); its C input has hysteresis (page 1).

The setup and hold reference edge is not spelled out for the latch; taken as C going low.
notes: Timing is the SN74LS373 table (page 7). SN74S373 (page 10, RL 280 ohm, CL 15 pF): D to Q 7/12 both edges, C to Q tPLH 7/14, tPHL 12/18, OC tPZH 8/15, tPZL 11/18, tPHZ 6/9, tPLZ 8/12 ns typ/max; setup 0 ns, hold 10 ns, pulse width 6 ns high, 7.3 ns low (page 9). Plain file: the lookup uses it for 74LS373 and 74S373.
